findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The chemical sanitizing dish machine was observed testing at 0ppm(CL). The chlorine chemical was finished. The facility mostly uses single service plates, however, pots and pans will need to be sanitized effectively. Discussed using the ware-washing sink inside of the main kitchen to sanitize dishes using bleach. The owner mentioned contacting MJ Kellner to get more chemical purchased. Will follow up on December 7, 2026 to ensure that chemical is available for dish machine.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There were mouse droppings observed on nonfood contact surfaces throughout the additional kitchen space. The owner mentioned that the facility does not contract a professional pest management company. Discussed the need to consult a pest control company to provide monthly treatment to the facility to reduce the presence of insects. Ensure that mouse droppings are cleaned and that both spaces are treated monthly. Will follow up on December 7, 2026 to see that the premises have been treated by a professional pest management company.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed a roll of ground beef and deli meat to not be date marked. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that TCS foods that are held in house longer than 24 hours are date marked and discarded if not used within 7 days. 

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Observed a bottle of bleach cleaner mixed in with food on a storage rack. PIC removed bottle from shelf. Ensure that chemicals are always stored separate from food to prevent contamination. 

7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
Observed discarded food and boxes on the porch outside of the back door. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that trash is stored in a receptacle and that it’s inaccessible to insects and rodents. 

5-501.110: REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be stored in receptacles or waste handling units so that they are inaccessible to insects and rodents.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Dish machine was observed with final rinse concentration of 0ppm chlorine. Container of concentrated product was changed approximately one week ago. Priming the sanitizer line resulted in a chlorine concentration of 100ppm. Three additional cycles were ran to verify proper function and consistent concentration. The concentration went down to 50ppm during the second cycle and was at 0ppm by the fourth cycle. Owner will call technician for service today. In the meantime, the detergent was dispensing properly, and the dish machine may be used for wash and rinse steps. Manual sanitization will occur at the prep sink in the main building after lunch is over. Sink used for sanitize step will be cleaned and sanitized prior to setting up solution for manual sanitization of dishes (immerse dishes for at least 10sec prior to air drying).
Chemical sanitizer used in sanitizing solution for manual or mechanical warewashing shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Maintain dish machine final rinse concentration no lower than 50ppm and no higher than 200ppm. Use test strips to verify concentration.
